affirmation.author: Brandon Payton <brandon.payton@a8c.com>
affirmation.behavioral_safety: At ABI 55 Kandelo syscall 304 (klogctl) was absent from the declared contract: it had no entry in syscalls, syscall_arg_descriptors or channel_scalar_contract, and the kernel answered every call with a fake success, returning 0 and leaving the caller's buffer untouched. An ABI-55 program could therefore observe nothing from syscall 304 but that 0, and nothing a program can usefully depend on. Giving 304 real kernel-message-ring behavior is safe for those programs because the only prior behavior it replaces is that fake success.
